Integrated LED strip lighting around the mirrors and the base of the unit.
Gold-colored hardware and decorative patterns on the drawer fronts.
Fluted or ribbed texture on the left-side cabinet door.
A matching white square stool/ottoman with a grey padded top.
Reflection in the mirror shows a tufted headboard, suggesting a bedroom setting.
The seller's text mentions a 'bed set' and 'two side [tables]', but these are not clearly pictured.
